list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A mononuclear, pentacoordinate lanthanum complex bearing two bulky PN^Terph ligands, with a distorted square-pyramidal coordination environment.

synthesis.procedure: Salt metathesis of KPN^Terph with lanthanum chloride–THF starting material in a 2:1 ratio in boiling toluene affords complex 1.

reagents.amount: 2 equivalents relative to lanthanum starting material
reagents.name: KPN^Terph

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two lanthanum centers, each supported by one PN^Terph ligand, are bridged by one mesitylphosphinidene and two mesitylphosphanido ligands.

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of mono-PN lanthanum complex 3 with eight equivalents of KPHMes gives complex 2. The article also reports obtaining single crystals of 2 after attempting the reaction of bis-PN complex 1 with KPHMes.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Single crystals were obtained from the alternative reaction starting with complex 1 after numerous crystallization attempts.
synthesis.yield: 49% from complex 3; 42% reported for the alternative route from complex 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A tetranuclear lanthanum ate scaffold composed of two dinuclear lanthanum units. Three chlorides bridge the lanthanum ions within each unit; further chloride linkages to potassium connect the two units.

synthesis.procedure: Salt metathesis of KPN^Terph with LaCl3(THF)1.2 in DME affords the mono-PN complex 3; the main text does not give a numerical reagent amount for this preparation.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature during hexane workup; initial reaction temperature not specified
synthesis.time: 12 hours for reaction; overnight during hexane workup
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After filtration and removal of volatiles in vacuo, the oily residue was dissolved in hexane and stirred overnight at room temperature. The suspension was filtered, washed with hexane (2 × 5 mL), and dried in vacuo.

title: A bridging bis-phosphanido-phosphinidene complex of lanthanum supported by a sterically encumbering PN ligand
